summary: Busy arterial kerb with no parking lane or shoulder; peak-hour no stopping.
reasons: Main road, no parked cars along kerb
Dwellings 14 m at end of stretch

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a small park on the south side, but a house sits 14 m from the east end and apartments 27-35 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight against trees with no pull-off or verge wide enough for a van; it is a live traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with a bus using it; heavy through traffic.
drivers.convention: No vehicles parked along this kerb; two Mon-Fri 4-6:30pm No Stopping signs.

flags: Steep in places: 3.7% mean, 8% max grade
Low-lying at about 7-9 m, 313 m from the Brisbane River
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the kerb from the south and west.
